notes.title: Build 800
notes.content:
Build 800

[list]
[*] The tutorial highlights fuel bricks in your inventory to let you know where they are to use.
[*] The game now launches in fullscreen by default.
[*] The monitor objects by the reactors in the engine carriage now useful display fuel totals.
[*] Interacting with dialogues will no longer cause key actions to get stuck on, hopefully.
[/list]

"With thanks to our eminent creative director (special responsibility for hats) and game tester, Jonathan Perkins."
